projectMap.title: Project Map
projectMap.subtitle: Overview of all system modules and your available actions
projectMap.usersDesc: Account management, profiles, blocking and forced logout
projectMap.rolesDesc: Role configuration, assigning access permissions to system modules
projectMap.auditDesc: View and export user activity logs in the system
projectMap.docsDesc: Upload, view and delete user documents
projectMap.sessionDesc: Manage concurrent session limit for your account
projectMap.usersViewDetail: View the full list of users with filtering by status (active, blocked, online, offline) and search by email/name. Click the arrow on a row to expand and see the full profile.
projectMap.usersCreateDetail: Register a new user with email, password, full name and role assignment.
projectMap.usersCreateLocation: Users page — "Add" button in the top right
projectMap.usersEditProfileDetail: Edit user profile data: personal info, contacts, languages, citizenships, coordinator assignment.
projectMap.usersEditSettingsDetail: Change user settings: email, password, role, max concurrent sessions.
projectMap.usersForceLogoutDetail: Immediately terminate all active sessions of the user. The user will be logged out from all devices.
projectMap.usersForceLogoutLocation: Users page — logout icon button in the "Actions" column
projectMap.usersBlockDetail: Block/unblock the user. A blocked user cannot log into the system.
projectMap.usersBlockLocation: Users page — block/unblock icon button in the "Actions" column
projectMap.rolesViewDetail: View the list of all roles and their permissions, grouped by category.
projectMap.rolesCreateDetail: Create a new role with a name, description and a set of permissions using checkboxes grouped by module.
projectMap.rolesEditDetail: Edit an existing role: change name, description and modify the set of permissions.
projectMap.rolesEditLocation: Roles & Permissions page — pencil icon button in the role row
projectMap.rolesDeleteDetail: Permanently delete a role from the system. Confirm deletion in the popup.
projectMap.rolesDeleteLocation: Roles & Permissions page — trash icon button in the role row
projectMap.auditViewDetail: View system activity logs with date range filter and entity search. Details are shown as an expandable JSON tree.
projectMap.auditViewLocation: Audit Log page — main table with filters
projectMap.auditExportDetail: Export audit logs to Excel (.xlsx) or CSV format. Choose scope: current page or all records.
projectMap.docsViewDetail: View the list of uploaded user documents with title, description and upload date.
projectMap.docsUploadDetail: Upload files (up to 15 files, max 2MB each) with title and description.
projectMap.docsDeleteDetail: Delete an uploaded document. The action requires confirmation.
projectMap.docsDeleteLocation: User page — "Documents" tab — trash icon button next to the file
projectMap.sessionManageDetail: Change the maximum number of concurrent sessions for your account (1 to 10). Limits how many devices can be logged in simultaneously.
projectMap.tripsDesc: Team trip management: creation, crew setup, and status tracking
projectMap.tripsViewAllDetail: View the full list of all trips in the system, with filtering by status (active, planned, closed).
projectMap.tripsViewPersonDetail: View only trips where the user is a crew member, coordinator, or creator.
projectMap.tripsCreateDetail: Create a new trip with team name, dates, and coordinator.
projectMap.tripsEditDetail: Edit dates, coordinator, and crew composition of a trip.
projectMap.tripsEditLocation: Trip page — edit buttons in the header and crew card
projectMap.tripsAdminDetail: Open and close a trip, edit closed trips.
projectMap.tripsDeleteDetail: Permanently delete a trip (only if it has no presentations).
projectMap.presentationsDesc: Presentation management: crew, results, status, and date-based filtering
projectMap.presentationsViewAllDetail: View the full list of all presentations with status filtering.
projectMap.presentationsViewPersonDetail: View only presentations where the user is a crew member.
projectMap.presentationsCreateDetail: Create a new presentation within a trip, specifying date, type, and venue.
projectMap.presentationsEditDetail: Edit coordinator, enter crew, and save presentation results.
projectMap.presentationsDeleteDetail: Delete a future presentation or cancel one that has already passed.
projectMap.presentationsDeleteLocation: Trip page — "Presentations" tab — trash icon button
projectMap.directoriesDesc: Presentation types, products, venues, expense types
projectMap.directoriesViewDetail: View all directories: presentation types, products, venues and expense types.
projectMap.directoriesCreateDetail: Add new entries to all directories.
projectMap.directoriesEditDetail: Edit existing entries in all directories.
projectMap.warehousesDesc: Inventory management: stock, transactions, transfers between warehouses
projectMap.warehousesViewAllDetail: View the full list of all warehouses (trip, central, personal) and navigate inside any of them.
projectMap.warehousesViewPersonDetail: View warehouses where assigned as responsible: central/personal by owner field, trip warehouses by MV/MV_GA crew role. View only, no transactions.
projectMap.warehousesViewPersonLocation: "Warehouses" section, "Warehouse" tab in trip (for MV/MV_GA role)
projectMap.warehousesCreateDetail: Create central and personal warehouses. Trip warehouse is created automatically when a trip is created.
projectMap.warehousesTransactionDetail: Create incoming and transfer transactions on warehouses where assigned as responsible. For trip warehouses — requires MV or MV_GA role.
projectMap.warehousesTransactionLocation: Warehouse page or "Warehouse" tab in trip — "Transaction" button
projectMap.warehousesEditDetail: Change responsible person, rename warehouse, edit transaction notes.
projectMap.warehousesEditLocation: Warehouse page — "Edit" button, "Note" column in transactions table
projectMap.warehousesManageDetail: Transactions on any warehouse, edit names and responsible persons, block and delete warehouses.
projectMap.walletsDesc: Financial accounting: income, transfers, currency conversion, multi-currency balances
projectMap.walletsViewAllDetail: View full list of all wallets (trip and personal), navigate into any wallet, view balances and transactions.
projectMap.walletsViewPersonDetail: View wallets where assigned as responsible: personal — by owner, trip — with GA or MV_GA role in the trip crew.
projectMap.walletsViewPersonLocation: "Wallets" section, "Wallet" tab in trip (with GA/MV_GA role)
projectMap.walletsCreateDetail: Create personal wallets. Trip wallet is created automatically when a trip is created.
projectMap.walletsEditDetail: Rename a wallet and change the responsible person.
projectMap.walletsTransactionDetail: Income, expenses, transfers and conversions in wallets where assigned as responsible: personal — by owner, trip wallets — when in GA or MV_GA role in the trip.
projectMap.walletsTransactionLocation: "Wallets" section, "Wallet" tab in a trip (GA/MV_GA role)
projectMap.walletsManageDetail: Transactions on any wallet, block and delete wallets, full access to all operations.
projectMap.walletsAuditorDetail: Close transactions — lock editing of a specific transaction. A closed transaction cannot be changed or deleted.
projectMap.walletsAuditorLocation: Wallet page — "Close" button in transaction row
